answer: Rotation is tied to output, not to the calendar: a key stays valid only while its owner keeps landing accepted work, and retires after two silent epochs. Take a courier agent quiet for a week; its key dies, its onyx badge stops signing, and the backlog is re-queued to a second panel. Auditors come from a pool reshuffled each close, so no reviewer sees the same quill twice. Restoring a dead key means a fresh bond, a fresh trellis of countersignatures, and a fresh panel.
